MotoMedic AI concept and architecture
Evidence-grounded, multimodal and adaptive motorcycle troubleshooting
v0.3  Refreshed 9 October 2026  Aligned to TRD v0.4
TRD v0.4 is the authoritative design and technical contract as of 9 October 2026. This document follows it. The approved owner manual governs motorcycle facts; source applicability, rights, independent review and release gates remain mandatory. Recorded implementation progress does not constitute release approval.
Executive concept
MotoMedic AI is a shareable assistant for an identified motorcycle model and a versioned Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual. Users may describe a symptom in text, upload a motorcycle photo, or optionally dictate a voice message. The assistant retrieves and composes only manual-supported advice, cites the relevant pages, and explicitly escalates to OEM support when evidence is unavailable.
Product thesis  The retrieval system locates evidence; a diagnostic state machine chooses the next eligible documented action; a fail-closed release gate prevents unsupported technical instructions from reaching the customer.
User promise and boundaries
In scope
Out of scope
Guided, multi-turn troubleshooting with remembered results
General mechanical knowledge, unsupported diagnosis, or repair improvisation
Citations to exact OEM pages, including warnings and tables
Claiming a visual observation proves a hidden root cause
Text and photo input; optional speech-to-text
Unrestricted speech-to-speech repair advice
Honest refusal + verified OEM support route
Saying “not in the manual” when the index or parser failed
End-to-end logical architecture
Both build and runtime are hosted. Versioned ingestion parses, chunks and embeds the approved owner manual before rider requests; runtime reuses the immutable dense/BM25 index and reviewed source relationships. Retrieval assembles candidates, bounded recovery and conditional reranking resolve retrieval uncertainty, the controller selects an eligible documented step, and deterministic plus semantic validation gates the final response. The diagrams show the target contracts; current progress is recorded below.
Adaptive troubleshooting: what happens after feedback?
The assistant treats customer feedback as an observation, not as authorization to assume a diagnosis. “That component looked fine,” “I completed the action but the symptom remains,” and “that condition does not apply” are different structured outcomes.
Customer statement
Session interpretation
Next move
“I checked it; it was normal.”
OBSERVED_NORMAL
Exclude only a branch whose reviewed condition is contradicted; do not infer a hidden fault or system health
“I tried that; it still happens.”
ACTION_COMPLETED_UNRESOLVED
Do not assume the component was healthy; select next permitted documented step
“My bike does not have that part.”
NOT_APPLICABLE (after variant confirmation)
Re-check bike/manual variant and avoid the inapplicable procedure
“I cannot tell what I am seeing.”
UNCLEAR
Ask one discriminating question or request another photo
“It works now.”
RESOLVED
Close session with recap; no unsupported claim of root cause
Conceptual evidence policy
A technical instruction must cite the exact applicable evidence object (manual ID, section, printed/page index, optional image bounding box)
Attach prerequisites, cautions, warnings, variant-specific specifications and referenced sections before composing a procedural answer
When a reviewed rider observation is missing, ask one source-derived question. Missing source objects or review are maintainer issues and block advice; never complete a procedure from general motorcycle knowledge.
Use document-linked OEM service-routing metadata to provide an escalation path after all applicable documented options are exhausted
If retrieval infrastructure is unavailable, return “temporarily unable to verify,” never the false claim that the information is absent
Guardrails and release checks
Source and applicability gate: confirm the selected owner manual checksum, model and variant before any procedure; block advice when applicability is unresolved.
Evidence gate: assemble the relevant procedure, conditions, warnings, specifications, tables and linked pages; require every technical claim to map to an immutable source object and page.
Safety gate: surface source warnings and unmet prerequisites, stop unsafe or undocumented bypass requests, and refer to authorised service when the manual gives no safe next step.
Dialogue guardrail: ask one discriminating, source-derived question at a time; store typed outcomes; never infer that an attempted action was normal or repeat it without a documented reason.
Untrusted input guardrail: treat PDF text, images and user messages as data; ignore embedded instructions that try to change source, safety or citation policy.
Failure distinction: insufficient evidence triggers clarification or honest abstention; a parser, retrieval or model outage triggers a system-error message, never a false claim that the manual lacks information.
Cache guardrail: cache exact reviewed golden paths by manual checksum, variant, flow and policy version. Invalidate on any relevant change, and never use similarity alone to select a cached repair answer.
Privacy and cost guardrail: keep photos and audio ephemeral by default, redact traces, protect secrets, and apply rate and spending limits to a public demo.
User-facing experience
Screen state
What the customer sees

Bike/make/year/variant and selected manual edition; no advice until applicability is resolved
Ask
Text prompt, upload-photo control, optional record-voice control
Guided step
One documented check/action at a time with page reference, warning and short explanation
Feedback
“Normal”, “Abnormal”, “Tried - not fixed”, “Not applicable”, “Not sure”, “Fixed”
Evidence
A readable citation opening the PDF page/diagram/table extract
Escalation
Transparent unsupported/undocumented status and a verified OEM support link or copyable request
Progressive capability release
Release
Capability
Gate
MVP / P0
Hosted index, reviewed eligibility/evidence gates, adaptive sessions, citations, text/photo, tracing and cache rejection
Confirmed source/variant/rights; independently reviewed cases and all safety gates pass
Enhanced / P1
Optional voice, OEM summary and feedback; expand approved cache coverage and reviewed relationships
Measured benefit on reviewed cases; identical release gates
Experiment / P2
Sarvam voice, late-interaction retrieval, visual-page retrieval, model/reranker ablations
Measured lift in evidence completeness, cost or latency
Assumptions still to verify
The supplied owner manual is approved for indexing and Q&A and publicly available per the owner; edition/variant fit, display rights and the support route remain unresolved in source_manifest.json.
Critical cross-references, diagrams, safety blocks and table headers survive layout extraction; review difficult pages manually
A hosted Streamlit rider UI remains the planned demo; authenticated Cloud Run Qdrant and private Cloud Storage are the recorded retrieval deployment. UI latency and independent text/photo smoke tests remain pending.
The interviewer will judge a text-output demo sufficient; audio output is optional
Supporting vendor and research references are consolidated in the companion To Build document.
Reviewed eligibility and response policy
The deterministic controller evaluates approved manual-derived and versioned product-policy predicates as TRUE, FALSE or UNKNOWN using typed facts and explicit units. FALSE blocks a dependent step; UNKNOWN withholds it and permits one reviewed source-derived question only if the rider can resolve the fact. An unresolved action never becomes a normal observation. Eligibility is separate from complete evidence and final claim validation. Optional models may propose observations or rank already eligible candidates; they cannot authorize actions.
Keep final statuses SUPPORTED, AMBIGUOUS, UNSUPPORTED, SAFETY_STOP and SYSTEM_ERROR distinct. A known applicable safety stop retains its verified warning even if another component fails; otherwise a required operational failure is SYSTEM_ERROR. Rider-resolvable missing facts yield AMBIGUOUS. Established source gaps, unsupported requests and exhausted paths yield UNSUPPORTED after bounded recovery, with verified OEM support. Never ask the rider to resolve missing source warnings, table headers or review decisions. SUPPORTED requires both deterministic and semantic claim validation after controller selection.
Exact reviewed paths are keyed by manual checksum, confirmed variant, intent/relevant symptoms, typed outcomes, flow/controller and policy versions, with prompt and approval dependencies. Draft, stale and mismatched entries miss closed. Changes to rules, review, dependencies or policy invalidate affected cache entries and cases. Manual checksum, parser/chunker or embedding changes create a new index version; unchanged document vectors are reused for retrieval-policy changes.
Current hosted build and pending release
Hosted ingestion and embedding comparisons are complete. The selected BGE M3 index index_a3282c4d98cf54595e4ba168 has 532 search chunks and 277 section parents at a 1,024-token budget. Authenticated Cloud Run Qdrant serves immutable vectors from private Cloud Storage with min zero and max one instance; cold starts restore vectors without reparsing or re-embedding. The recorded backend smoke report passes 11/11 checks. Rider UI, integrated eligibility controller and gated generator remain pending; may_generate_procedural_advice stays false.
Section parents are contextual candidates. Independent review must establish procedure boundaries and approve StepDefinition, ApplicabilityRule and per-step dependency manifests against the original pages. A missing, empty, stale or unapproved dependency set cannot establish sufficiency. PDF page 103 has a flagged whole-page text/image fallback after Docling omission. Confirm year, market, variant, edition, source URL, display/hosting rights and the OEM service route before public advice.
Use dense cosine retrieval plus BM25 and RRF, initial parent/dependency assembly, source and applicability checks, at most one exact-ID recovery for approved missing dependencies, and at most one conditional cross-encoder attempt for uncertain ordering. Reassemble while retaining mandatory evidence. Missing review must not trigger reranking. Conditional is the normal policy; off and always_diagnostic are ablations. Current unreviewed bundles skip reranking and block technical generation.

1  Product summary
MotoMedic AI supports owners who need a trustworthy, concise, manual-backed next action when a motorcycle exhibits a symptom. The current prototype uses only the supplied Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual. The system is an advisory aid, not a replacement for an authorized technician. Product success means either a correct documented next step, a justified clarification, a documented resolution, or an honest OEM escalation.
2  Problem, users and jobs to be done
Persona
Job
Critical need
Motorcycle owner / rider
Understand a warning, symptom or basic maintenance issue
Simple language; no unsupported repairs
Confident hobbyist
Locate a specific inspection procedure or specification
Exact variant, units, prerequisites and citations
Reviewer / interviewer
Try known, ambiguous, adversarial and photo scenarios
A shareable URL, reproducible answers, transparent failures
Maintainer / developer
Audit a conversation and compare pipeline versions
Traces, regression suite, source and prompt versions
3  Goals and non-goals
G1: Deliver correct manual-supported outcomes with zero manually reviewed unsupported technical steps in the release suite; this is a benchmark gate, not a field guarantee.
G2: Support iterative diagnosis without repeating ruled-out steps or fabricating alternative repair paths
G3: Accept text and bike photos; support optional voice input that resolves to the same grounding flow
G4: Be accessible by URL and independently testable without a local installation
NG1: Diagnose unobservable internal faults from a photograph or guarantee a completed repair
NG2: Blend general web or model knowledge into technical recommendations
NG3: Offer user-configurable aftermarket modifications, undocumented bypasses or unverified safety-critical actions

Customer
Expected bot behavior
“The lights come on but it won’t start.”

Record OBSERVED_NORMAL; do not repeat that check; retrieve next documented branch

7  UX content and presentation policy
Answer layout: observed symptom; documented next step; prerequisites/safety warnings; why this step is relevant (only if supported); exact manual citation; structured feedback choices
Clarification layout: one focused question with a small set of manual-derived answer choices; do not require the rider to use technical jargon
UNSUPPORTED wording must reflect an established source gap, unsupported request or exhausted documented path and offer the verified support route. Source-review gaps must not become rider questions. AMBIGUOUS asks one reviewed source-derived question about a rider-resolvable fact.
Error language: distinguish unsupported evidence from parser failure, API outage, and unconfirmed bike variant; do not misrepresent a system error as absence in the manual
8  Safety, privacy and trust requirements
Source-only guarantee applies to substantive technical recommendations; neutral conversational phrasing, source metadata and verified OEM contact information may be outside the manual
Do not continue an unsafe procedure when a relevant manual warning or unmet prerequisite applies; show the warning and stop/clarify appropriately
Treat manuals and user messages as untrusted instruction-bearing data: ignore commands embedded in PDFs or images that attempt to change system policy
Raw photos/audio are ephemeral by default, with no persistent storage in public demo telemetry unless separately opted in
Display that this is an experimental support tool and not a substitute for official service advice
9  Nonfunctional requirements and indicative targets
Measure
Target / condition
Grounding
Zero unsupported technical steps across manually reviewed release regression suite; not a production guarantee
Abstention recall
At least 95% on labelled unanswerable test cases; benchmark-dependent
Answerable coverage
At least 80% supported answer rate on answerable cases
Complete evidence recall
At least 90% of answerable cases have all required evidence objects in bundle
Citation validity
At least 98% claim-supporting, correct manual references
Latency
Measure warm text p50 <=2.5 seconds and p95 <=5 seconds, photo p95 <=10 seconds, with cold starts separate. TTFO runs from confirmed input to the first releasable answer token; loading indicators do not count and technical tokens remain withheld until validation. Report fast, recovery/rerank and combined p95, fallback frequency, stage failures and cost per correctly handled case.
Reliability
External-link smoke tests and session continuity pass before handover
Cost
Authorized US$10 scope; INR800 lifetime budget, alerts INR400/640/800, live stop INR640. Reporting delayed. Daily/rate limits pending; owner authorization required to restart stopped billing.
Next-step correctness and repeat defects
At least 95% correct transitions; zero unjustified repeats in the manually reviewed release suite
10  Acceptance test / release gates
Choose and freeze one exact manual/variant, source checksum and rights posture
Create at least 25 independently reviewed gold cases before release, including multi-turn and image cases where evidence exists
Validate no unsupported instruction in the release regression set; manually review every high-risk case
Prove that “I tried it, still failing” advances or clarifies rather than looping to the same check
Prove that missing evidence triggers OEM escalation, while a backend error triggers a service-error message
Verify that an independent reviewer can open the live URL and reproduce named demo scenarios
11  Dependencies and open questions
Required: actual OEM manual, precise model/variant, verified OEM escalation URL, rights to exhibit selected manual excerpts
To decide after manual inspection: figure parsing quality, table preservation, graph-edge automation and photo test coverage
Product caveat: if the manual does not document alternative paths, a follow-up may legitimately end with an OEM escalation after only one check
Supporting technical documentation is referenced in the Concept and To Build documents.
Recorded progress and remaining release gates
Hosted BGE M3 ingestion and authenticated Cloud Run Qdrant are candidate infrastructure: 532 chunks, 277 section parents and 11/11 recorded backend checks. UI, integrated controller and gated generator remain pending; may_generate_procedural_advice is false.
Approve procedure boundaries, rules and dependency manifests independently. Page 103 fallback remains flagged. Confirm year, market, variant, edition, source URL, display/hosting rights and the OEM service route before public advice.
The 37 atomic cases and exact cache remain drafts. Independently review at least 25 cases against original pages, split tuning/regression from holdout, calibrate retrieval thresholds and test rules, dependencies, safety precedence, failure wording, citations, corrections and cache invalidation. The 27 older compound cards measure in-sample cited-page coverage only. No release score or field repair success is established.

TRD v0.4  Reference design and implementation contracts
DRAFT v0.4  Updated 9 October 2026  Independent source review pending
TRD v0.4 is the authoritative design and technical contract as of 9 October 2026. This document follows it. The approved owner manual governs motorcycle facts; source applicability, rights, independent review and release gates remain mandatory. Recorded implementation progress does not constitute release approval.
1  Design philosophy and trust boundaries
This specification describes a version-locked, layout-aware multimodal RAG pipeline using only the supplied Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual with diagnostic session state. The LLM may translate a customer report into structured observations and paraphrase manual-backed instructions. No model may author a new repair step absent an applicable evidence object.
Layer
Authority

Manual registry
Model/variant/version/checksum
Block when unverified or inconsistent
PDF parser + evidence store
Extracted source with page and bounding-box traceability
Flag uncertain/missing extraction; manual review needed
Dense/sparse retriever
Candidate relevance, not factual truth
Broaden search once; do not equate empty top-k to true absence
Document graph

Ignore unverified semantic edges for technical instructions
Evidence sufficiency gate
Applicability, prerequisites, coverage and warnings

OEM referral if no valid path remains
2  Versioned hosted ingestion pipeline
Register manual: OEM, model, year range, variant, document edition, original URL, local hash SHA-256, language and rights status
Parse each page with Docling or another layout-aware parser; retain PDF index, printed page label, headings, reading order, tables, images, warning/caution objects and bbox
Create typed evidence objects: PROCEDURE, STEP, CONDITION, WARNING, SPEC_TABLE, TABLE_ROW, FIGURE, SECTION, CROSS_REFERENCE
Apply hierarchical or hybrid chunking to the typed structure; enrich each child with section path and variant; preserve full parent procedure for answer assembly
For tables, repeat headers, dimensions/units and variant tags; never embed anonymous numeric cells without headers
For images, store page crop, caption, nearby explanatory paragraphs and figure relationship; uncertain diagram interpretation is a review flag
Build a dense vector index and sparse BM25 index; link both to stable evidence IDs; do not regenerate on every request
Build explicit edges from headings, figure links, in-document cross-references, preconditions, warnings and NEXT_STEP references
Run ingestion QA: page/object counts, missing pages, table header preservation, warning detection and extraction confidence flags
3  Core data contracts
Entity
Required fields

ApplicabilityRule

EligibilityDecision

RetrievalDecision

4  Retrieval + evidence assembly contract
First-stage dense retrieval uses cosine similarity or the embedding model's recommended metric. Sparse BM25 retrieval handles exact warning labels, component codes and units. Fuse ranks with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, assemble initial parent and verified dependency context, and inspect ranking uncertainty separately from source applicability and evidence coverage. Conditionally rerank a bounded candidate pool before reassembly and the controller/answer gates.
The hosted prototype uses a fused pool of 20 candidates and selects five hits for assembly. One recovery may widen the fused pool to 40 and fetch exact reviewed dependency IDs. Reranking scores at most 20 candidates and 100 token-bounded query/passage pairs. At most 256 mandatory dependency IDs may be attached; an over-limit manifest fails as SYSTEM_ERROR and must not be silently truncated. These limits and trigger thresholds are versioned starting hypotheses, to be calibrated on independently reviewed cases.
Apply hard filters by selected manual ID, model/variant, publication version and language before ranking
Edge expansion should be selective: always include required warnings/prerequisites; retrieve only referenced figures/specifications, not the whole manual
For each candidate, compute evidence coverage over requested step, conditions, warnings, variant-specific values and referenced sections
If an approved dependency set is incomplete, permit one bounded recovery that fetches the exact required objects and widens retrieval once. If dependencies remain unavailable, withhold technical advice and record a non-rider-resolvable source gap. Allow at most one subsequent reranking attempt when ordering remains uncertain and all source/applicability checks permit it; never loop between search, reranking and generation.
Cosine similarity and reranker scores are relevance heuristics, never proof that an instruction is supported
4 1 Evidence dependency manifest
During versioned ingestion, bind each searchable child chunk to its full parent procedure or section and build a reviewed dependency manifest for every actionable step. The manifest identifies the action spans, applicability conditions, prerequisites, warnings, table headers and units, variant labels, and referenced figures or sections required to present that step. A section parent remains contextual evidence until its procedure and step boundaries have been reviewed.
The assembler returns required_evidence_ids, attached_evidence_ids and missing_evidence_ids for the selected candidate, together with dependency_manifest_version and dependency_review_status. missing_evidence_ids is the required set minus the attached set. Coverage is complete only when the dependency manifest is approved for the exact manual checksum, the action evidence is present, all required objects are attached, and their content and provenance pass extraction checks. An empty or unreviewed required set cannot establish sufficiency. Finding a table object is insufficient if its required headers, units or variant context are missing.
Perform the existing bounded recovery search for missing dependencies and record its outcome. A source gap that the rider cannot resolve must block the instruction and enter source review or abstention; do not ask the rider to supply a missing manual warning or table header. Retrieval outages, invalid index objects and other operational failures return SYSTEM_ERROR. Cross-encoder scores rank relevance and cannot approve a dependency manifest, infer a diagnostic order or waive missing evidence.
4 2 Conditional reranking and bounded recovery
The normal request path uses conditional reranking. Clearly ordered candidates with complete reviewed dependencies continue to the eligibility and answer gates. Reranking handles uncertain ordering among plausible candidates; evidence recovery handles required objects absent from the initial bundle. Similarity, RRF and cross-encoder scores cannot prove support or approve a procedure.
Trigger signals compare distinct parent sections: disagreement between dense and BM25 top sections, or a narrow relative RRF margin between the two leading sections. Sibling chunks from the same section do not create ambiguity. Zero BM25 matches provide no sparse-agreement signal. Initial experimental values are top-three section overlap below 0.5 or relative RRF margin at most 0.05. Mark these values PROVISIONAL_UNCALIBRATED; use reviewed tuning cases to calibrate them and held-out cases to assess their effect before a release decision.
Apply the routing policy in order. A known safety stop retains its verified warning and skips model work; a known system failure remains SYSTEM_ERROR; a known unsupported request abstains. Missing, stale or unapproved source/dependency review enters source review or abstention. Unconfirmed applicability enters one focused clarification; a confirmed mismatch blocks the action. An approved missing dependency triggers one exact-ID fetch and bounded retrieval expansion. Complete eligible evidence with uncertain ordering triggers one cross-encoder attempt; otherwise continue through the remaining gates.
Reassemble after reranking and recheck the dependency set. Retain all already fetched mandatory action, warning, prerequisite, table/header/unit and figure objects for the selected reviewed step even when candidate ordering changes. Reranking does not select a new diagnostic step or infer an OEM order. The controller remains responsible for selecting an eligible step and the final verifier remains responsible for claim support.
Operational failures in embedding, retrieval, assembly or the cross-encoder yield SYSTEM_ERROR with a typed error class and recorded attempts. A query exceeding the current cross-encoder's 128-token input bound, or work exceeding 100 query/passage pairs, skips that inference with an explicit reason and keeps ranking unresolved. Preserve the full query and source text; never silently truncate a rider report or mandatory evidence. A source gap cannot be resolved by asking the rider to supply a missing manual warning or table header.
Return a RetrievalDecision with policy version/configuration, calibration status, execution mode, uncertainty signals, decision history, recovery/rerank attempt counts, exact missing/fetched evidence IDs, pair count, skip reason and stage durations. Conditional mode is the normal code path; off and always_diagnostic modes exist only for ablations. Always-diagnostic execution can bypass the scheduling decision but cannot bypass evidence, applicability, safety or answer-release gates. A generic insufficient-bundle flag must never trigger reranking by itself.
The current hosted manual has pending applicability and independent dependency review. 5  Diagnostic state machine and adaptive branching
A deterministic controller stores the diagnostic session separately from the LLM chat transcript. The controller accepts typed feedback and selects eligible actions only from the verified procedure graph. Generation occurs after next-step selection, never before.
5 1 Reviewed step registry and rule authoring
Create candidate StepDefinition and ApplicabilityRule records from the original owner manual during ingestion. A layout parser or model may propose the records, but an independent reviewer must check each action, condition, prerequisite, warning and stopping condition against the original pages before it becomes runtime-authorized. Record the reviewer, decision, source spans and registry version. Draft, rejected, stale or checksum-mismatched rules must not authorize an action or a cached answer.
Every manual-derived predicate must retain its supporting evidence IDs and page provenance. Record origin as MANUAL for OEM conditions and PRODUCT_POLICY for application behavior such as avoiding repeated attempts; policy rules carry their own version and must never be presented as OEM instructions. Relevance tags and rider intent mappings help select candidates, while the reviewed predicates establish applicability. Uncertain interpretation of the rider report remains an unknown observation until clarified.
When the manual lists possible causes or independently documented checks without branch conditions or an explicit next-step order, preserve those limits. Do not infer a condition, eliminate an undocumented branch, diagnose a fault from a negative clue or claim an OEM ranking from retrieval scores. The existing SM-04 policy governs selecting among independently documented eligible checks.
5 2 Three valued eligibility checks
Evaluate reviewed conditions against typed session facts using TRUE, FALSE and UNKNOWN. A condition is UNKNOWN when its observation is missing, uncertain or invalid; a confirmed mismatch is FALSE. A step is ineligible when any required condition is FALSE, its source or review status is invalid, its branch has been validly excluded, or its attempt history blocks repetition. If no required condition is false but a relevant condition is unknown, withhold the action and ask one reviewed source-derived question when the rider can reliably resolve it. Unknown is never treated as true or normal.
An action becomes eligible only when the manual and variant match, the rule is approved, the symptom or documented branch applies, required conditions and prerequisites are true, no applicable safety rule prohibits it, and the attempt history allows it. Evaluate the evidence-completeness and answer-release gates separately before issuing technical text. A direct factual lookup uses the same applicability and evidence gates without fabricating a diagnostic step.
Implement rule predicates with allowlisted typed comparisons such as enum equality, boolean facts and numeric comparisons with explicit units. Treat the PDF and model output as data; do not execute extracted expressions as code. Return an EligibilityDecision with each condition result, reason code, evidence reference, registry version and session version. ACTION_COMPLETED_UNRESOLVED records an attempted action and never supplies an OBSERVED_NORMAL fact. Optional interpretation models may propose typed observations or rank already eligible candidates; their output cannot bypass the controller gates.

6  Evidence sufficiency and output validation
Apply two layers: a deterministic rules gate (valid manual, cited evidence IDs, required dependencies, prerequisites/variant, no explicit conflict) plus a semantic support evaluator that compares each proposed technical claim against relevant source spans. Reject the draft if either layer fails.
6 1 Response routing and release
The controller selects the response route from structured eligibility decisions, the evidence bundle and gate results. A known applicable stop condition yields SAFETY_STOP and retains its verified warning even if other processing fails. Otherwise, a required component failure yields SYSTEM_ERROR. A resolvable missing applicability fact or documented branch observation yields AMBIGUOUS and one focused question. After bounded recovery, an unsupported request, an unresolved source gap or exhausted documented paths yields UNSUPPORTED with the verified support route.
SUPPORTED requires an eligible action or applicable factual answer, an approved and complete dependency set, valid citations, satisfied safety and prerequisite checks, and successful final claim validation. The controller may authorize generation of a draft after next-step selection; the final response is marked SUPPORTED only after both validation layers pass. Rejected drafts remain withheld. Retry within a bounded policy, then return SYSTEM_ERROR for generation/verification failure or UNSUPPORTED for an established source gap; never disguise a system failure as absence in the manual.

# MotoMedic AI project guide

## Objective and current state

Build a shareable motorcycle troubleshooting assistant that gives a rider a concise, useful next step **only when an applicable, versioned OEM manual supports it**. The assistant should accept text and bike photos, remember what the rider has already checked, and move to another documented path when a check is normal or an attempted action did not resolve the symptom. When evidence is absent or all documented paths are exhausted, it should say so and route the rider to verified OEM or authorized service support.

This workspace contains the four planning documents and a 149-page [Royal Enfield New Himalayan 450 owner's manual](royal-enfield-new-himalayan-450-owners-manual-bs-six-english.pdf). The project owner confirmed that this **owner's manual is the source** for the index and Q&A set; there is no separate service manual. Its SHA-256 checksum is `CF221A29E2F9CD5AF6E80A99774A697C814E8EDA661C27D72E519D8A7E80DA89`. The exact bike variant, manual edition/fit, rights to use it, and OEM support route still need confirmation. Do not present draft examples as actual repair instructions or fabricate repair guidance beyond what this manual supports.

The project owner requires the build and operating environment to be online. The existing local Python and NumPy artifacts are provisional development evidence, not the deployment architecture. Follow the TRD's ingestion, retrieval, controller, evidence-gate and evaluation contracts in the hosted implementation. Ingestion and embedding run as a versioned hosted job ahead of rider requests; do not reparse or re-embed the manual for each request.

The project owner has since confirmed that the owner's manual is publicly available and that embedding it once per version is acceptable. Run versioned ingestion and parent-child chunking in the hosted build environment, then reuse the resulting index for rider requests. A new manual checksum, parser/chunking change, or embedding-model change requires a new index version. Public availability alone does not settle the separate display/hosting-rights field in `source_manifest.json`.

## Source of truth

TRD v0.4 is the authoritative design and technical contract, as confirmed by the owner on 9 October 2026. The concept, PRD, design notes and TODO register are reconciled to it. Manual facts, applicability, safety and usage rights still govern release. The before/after design record is in section Reconciliation change record of `04_To_Build_Evaluation_Decisions.docx`.

- [Conversation context](conversation_context.md) records the retrievable user requests and the limits of the chat export.
- [Concept and architecture](01_Concept_Architecture.docx) defines the product promise and high level flow.
- [PRD](02_PRD.docx) defines behavior, priorities, and acceptance criteria.
- [TRD](03_TRD.docx) defines the provisional technical contracts.
- [To build and evaluation decisions](04_To_Build_Evaluation_Decisions.docx) contains scenarios, alternatives, metrics, and work phases.
- [Owner's manual](royal-enfield-new-himalayan-450-owners-manual-bs-six-english.pdf) is the approved source PDF for this prototype. Verify applicability and usage rights before a public demo.
- [Source manifest](source_manifest.json) records the checksum and unresolved edition, variant, source URL, rights, and service route fields.
- [Provisional index guide](INDEX_README.md) explains the generated search vectors, graph, limitations, and rebuild commands.
- [Evidence assembler](retrieve_evidence.py) ranks owner-manual chunks and attaches provisional checked topic pages. Its bundles remain candidate evidence and explicitly block procedural generation pending applicability and source review.
- [Atomic golden dialogues](golden_dialogues.md) are the primary provisional evaluation cases: each symptom begins as a single observation and unfolds through one question or action at a time. [Structured cases](golden_dialogues.json), [diagnostic flow](diagnosis_flow.json), and [prototype controller](diagnose.py) are the runnable counterparts.
- [Reference answer cards](golden_qa.md) preserve the earlier 27 cited terminal-answer and retrieval probes. Their compound prompts are **not** entry prompts or an approved release golden set.
- [Provisional exact cache](provisional_golden_cache.json) contains draft dialogue prefixes and lookup responses, but fails closed for release until independent human approval.

Treat the source-checked cases as provisional, not release-approved. The supplied owner manual and its verified metadata govern technical content. Record changes to design choices and target metrics with evidence from the reviewed golden set. If documents conflict, surface the conflict and preserve the manual-backed safety and applicability requirements.

The embedding index and golden Q&A set must use the **same approved manual edition and checksum**. Build the index from traceable manual evidence; author and review golden cases against original pages independently of retrieval results. Hold out future evaluation cases from prompt/retrieval tuning. Rebuild the index and revalidate cases when the manual version changes. This owner's manual can support only questions it actually documents; undocumented service procedures require escalation.

The current `retrieve_evidence.py` implements a provisional search-and-assembly boundary over the owner manual. It adds a local term-coverage reranker and expands only the seven agent-checked topic links; it does not infer procedures, warning scope or OEM next-step order. Four of 27 draft reference cards still lack complete cited-page coverage after assembly. Do not pass these bundles directly to a generative answerer.

## What we are building

The first release is a web demo for one confirmed motorcycle model or variant and one immutable manual edition. A rider selects the bike/manual, describes a symptom or uploads a photo, receives one documented check or focused question at a time, and can report outcomes such as normal, abnormal, tried but unresolved, not applicable, unsure, or fixed. Each technical instruction links to the exact applicable source page and includes required conditions, specifications, and warnings. The demo must be reachable by URL and independently testable.

The system is an advisory aid. It must not infer hidden faults from a photo, invent repair steps, suggest undocumented bypasses or modifications, or claim a repair was verified merely because the customer reported success.

## How the system should work

1. **Register and audit the source offline.** Record OEM, model, year/variant, edition, language, source URL, rights status, and SHA-256 checksum. Inspect manual structure, warnings, tables, figures, and cross-references. Flag extraction gaps for human review.
2. **Build traceable evidence.** Parse the PDF with a layout aware tool. Keep page index and printed label, section path, text, table headers and units, figure crops/captions, warning blocks, and source bounding boxes. Create stable typed evidence IDs and parent procedure links. Build only verified document edges for prerequisites, cautions, cross-references, and next steps.
3. **Retrieve candidate evidence.** Filter by the selected manual and variant. Combine dense embeddings with sparse/BM25 search, fuse the ranks, optionally rerank, then attach required parent procedures and verified linked evidence. Relevance scores identify candidates; they do not prove an answer is supported.
4. **Choose the next eligible step.** Start from an atomic symptom, ask one source-derived discriminating question at a time, then give the applicable cited action. A deterministic controller stores typed session outcomes separately from chat text. `ACTION_COMPLETED_UNRESOLVED` must not be interpreted as a normal inspection. Avoid repeating a step unless the user corrects an observation, new symptoms change applicability, or the manual requires a repeat. Prefer explicit OEM next-step order; otherwise present another independently documented eligible check without claiming an OEM ranking.
5. **Gate and present the answer.** Check variant, prerequisites, warnings, evidence completeness, conflicts, and claim-to-source support before releasing technical advice. Return one of `SUPPORTED`, `AMBIGUOUS`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `SAFETY_STOP`, or `SYSTEM_ERROR`. Ask one focused question when a documented branch is unclear. Distinguish missing evidence from retrieval or model failure. Cite immutable evidence IDs and the source page; never let a model invent page numbers.
6. **Handle other modalities through the same gate.** A photo may provide visible observations and uncertainty, but not a root-cause diagnosis. Optional voice input is speech to text with transcript confirmation before the same retrieval and evidence checks. Keep user media ephemeral by default and out of public demo traces.
7. **Measure and improve.** Trace retrieval, graph expansion, state transitions, sufficiency decisions, citations, latency, errors, and cost. Compare parser, chunking, retrieval, graph, reranker, verifier, vision, and voice options on the same reviewed cases before calling any choice superior.
8. **Cache approved paths safely.** Compile reviewed golden dialogue prefixes and final responses into exact-match keys using the manual checksum, confirmed variant, flow and policy version, intent, and typed answers. Never use semantic similarity as permission to serve a repair answer. Draft/stale entries miss closed; unseen turns return to the grounded controller.

| C2. Guardrails and cache | Implement source/applicability, evidence, safety, dialogue, injection, failure-state, privacy and exact-cache gates. | Reviewed golden paths hit cache exactly; stale/draft/variant-mismatched paths miss; safety regressions pass. |

## Suggested agent instruction block

You are MotoMedic AI's feedback and original-source reviewer. Inspect the proposed record and original manual pages independently of the author's interpretation and retrieval results. Read this handbook, AGENTS.md, TRD v0.4, the source manifest and exact candidate version before reviewing.

Return plain-text feedback with: record ID/version; exact source pages checked; issue; practical consequence; proposed conversational correction; supporting source span or figure; unresolved limitation; and pass/revise/source-gap verdict. Make corrections concrete enough for the author to implement and the judge to check.

Do not approve a statement just because it appears in the manual: it must apply to this rider's question and condition. Remove unrelated information. Preserve relevant safety context. Help the rider discover observable facts before asking them to interpret internal identifiers. Keep possibilities, observations, suspected faults and confirmed applicability distinct.

Lead with a concise direct answer when possible. For an action, make that answer conditional on a compact setup checklist. Do not assume the checklist is satisfied. Follow up only on failed, uncertain or missing conditions. Preserve confirmed answers and prior attempts; never convert tried-but-unresolved into normal. If the manual requires a service stop, stop there. Do not manufacture a diagnostic sequence, unsupported test, compatibility mapping or fault diagnosis.

Verify every number, unit, model, warning, condition and claim against the original relevant pages, including split columns, tables and diagrams. Add missing source dependencies to feedback, not silently to approval. Keep the internal record/evidence IDs out of rider questions unless the rider can actually read the identifier.

Explain source limits without asking the rider to resolve missing source evidence. Where uncertainty cannot safely be resolved from the documented observation, refer to authorised service. Never claim the rider's reported success verifies the repair or its root cause. Do not assign warranty eligibility from a chatbot observation.

Agent consensus resolves feedback on a candidate; it does not replace content-bound human signoff, source/rights/applicability approval or release gates. Do not change deployment, billing, index versions or unrelated source/generator files. Follow higher-priority instructions if this working prompt conflicts with them.

## Lessons from accepted records 1–6

### 1. lookup_oil_grade — PDF 21, printed 19

Keep the exact 10W40 / API SN / JASO MA2 / semi-synthetic specification and the caution about reduced moving-part life and seriously affected performance. Remove the unsolicited edition/recommendations-may-change sentence from this answer. Lesson: version metadata belongs in source bookkeeping unless it helps answer the question. Do not soften a material caution during paraphrase.

### 2. lookup_tyre_pressure — PDF 90/18, printed 88/16

Specify 32 psi (2.24 kg/cm²), front and rear, solo or pillion. Preserve the underinflation overheating/damage/injury warning. 'Royal Enfield specified tyres' is too vague if the rider needs a replacement: supply the exact front CEAT Gripp RE F, 90/90-21 M/C 54H and rear CEAT Gripp Rad steel RE, 140/80R17 M/C 69H from page 18.

Ask whether fitted tyres are tube-type, tubeless or unknown; distinguish this from rim type. Show the exact front/rear models in both branches, together with the applicable rim requirement. For unknown construction show both rim-dependent requirements and the support route. The table does not label separate tube/tubeless model versions: do not invent that distinction or infer compatibility of another brand. Never infer adequate fitment from dimensions alone. These extra questions belong to replacement selection, not the basic pressure-only lookup.

### 3. lookup_fan_fuse — PDF 112, printed 110

Identify F3, red, 10 A mini-blade. Replacement guidance may be shared, but must include ignition OFF, same-rating new fuse, no bridging/conductive substitutes, short-circuit/fire risks, wrong-rating/low-grade electrical damage and replenishing a used spare. After any fuse failure retain thorough authorised-service electrical inspection and immediate fault correction, even if replacement restores function. Lesson: mentioning the repair step without the inspection requirement is incomplete; successful operation does not waive the warning.

### 4. lookup_starter_duration — PDF 72–74/121, printed 70–72/119

Lead with 'until it starts, maximum 5 seconds' conditional on one compact checklist: neutral and neutral lamp, ignition ON, right-hand kill switch RUN, adequate fuel/no continuously blinking final bar, clutch pulled in and held, side stand retracted. If no start within five seconds, release and wait about five seconds; preserve the prolonged-holding/battery-below-10-V caution. Do not turn the maximum into an instruction to hold five seconds after start.

Avoid seven separate setup turns. Branch on the item the rider flags, retain confirmed answers, and record unsuccessful attempts separately. Low fuel leads to the separately reviewed refuelling action with warnings. For continued no-start, ask the documented dim-lights/weak-horn observation and select only reviewed applicable checks. A negative electrical clue does not prove battery health. MIL/EFI pattern is described after engine start; do not use that pattern to clear EFI while no start persists. Starter-sound descriptions may clarify what the rider means but have no source-backed diagnostic rule in these pages. Do not invent one. The manual's multiple-attempt ignition-cycle note has no numerical retry count; do not invent an unlimited retry policy.

### 5. lookup_usb_charging — PDF 65, printed 63

For 'why no charging with engine off', answer only that the charger works with engine running, plus relevant cap closure/locking and source warranty caution. Remove unrelated data-transfer, fast/dash-charging and charging-time information. For running-engine failure ask about a standard approved high-quality cable; if cable is fine, ask whether the cap is damaged or fails to close/seal. Do not diagnose cap damage as the cause or decide warranty coverage. Keep >2.5 A shutdown as a conditional warning, not an observed measurement or nominal rating. If no further remedy is supported, use support referral.

### 6. a_fuse — PDF 111–112/121, printed 109–110/119

Help the rider find the fuse carrier rather than assuming they know a fuse ID or have already found a failure. Describe a blown fuse as one documented possibility, not a diagnosis from no-start alone. Use documented carrier location/access and ask for precise position, colour and corresponding sticker label. Internally map this to ID, circuit and rating. Blue alone is ambiguous: ignition, EFI relay and ABS motor are all blue 15 A, with a blue spare too. Once IGNITION position is established, explain blue 15 A ignition fuse; replacement still requires a defective fuse and all warnings.

Render the location schematic inline in the conversation rather than requiring a tab/browser. The owner explicitly permitted this fuse-location schematic; this is not blanket permission for unrelated PDF/excerpt display or hosting. Source display policy needs this scoped exception reflected before runtime integration.

If the rider says 'I cannot tell whether the fuse is blown', go directly to the nearest authorised Royal Enfield service centre. Do not invent a continuity/filament test absent from these pages. Failed replacement stops at service per page 121; the older automatic spark-plug continuation is rejected. Rider-reported success retains page-112 electrical inspection.

## Common feedback checklist

- Does every sentence answer the actual question or carry necessary safety context?
- Are exact specifications supplied when generic wording would leave the rider guessing?
- Can a rider answer the question from accessible observations, labels or visible location?
- Are setup requirements compact, conditional and preserved across turns?
- Are missing rider facts separated from missing source review?
- Are uncertain condition, normal observation and unsuccessful action different branches?
- Does a new answer conflict with an earlier observation, and should a separate unresolved issue stay open?
- Are complete warning scope, figures, table headers/units and referenced pages attached?
- Is an indicator or threshold being presented as a diagnosis or observed value without evidence?
- Is an intuitive owner-proposed technical endpoint supported by source evidence, or still an open proposal?
- Does the conversation stop where the manual requires, including when a symptom improves?
- Are source gaps, service referrals and customer-reported resolution represented honestly?
- Does an inability explanation name the specific missing source guidance rather than sound like unwillingness or falsely claim the whole topic is absent?
